title: Replication Data for: Quantifying plasticity of children’s visions of nature
descriptions: Purpose: data underlying article: Holmgren et al. 2025 Earth Stewardship: Quantifying plasticity of children’s visions of nature. Nature: quantitative results of surveys containing three exercises assessing the normative, expressive and cognitive dimensions of nature perception of children before and directly after nature education activities (excursion and nature-themed games) in the Venice lagoon Scope: anonymized quantitative data from surveys taken from 120 children aged 11-12 from six classes and three schools in Venice
